headline.purpose: The place name in the popup strike.

wordmark.purpose: Lowercase "alibi" beside the mark in the popup header.

body.purpose: Guide prose in faded ink, max 34rem.

field.purpose: Typed values in address lines, tabular.

ui.purpose: Tabs, ink buttons, switch titles, the mode heading.

meta.purpose: Strike lead/meta lines, errors, link buttons, postal label.

label.purpose: Uppercase postal-form labels above address lines.

die-caps.purpose: City and country on the die arcs (SVG units).

die-time.purpose: Live local time inside the die (SVG units).

shadows.name: focus-underline
shadows.purpose: Thickens a focused or invalid address-line rule; a line, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: Die strike (320ms), halves fill slide (260ms), tab underline (200ms).

motion.name: strike-delay
motion.purpose: New die lands after the old one starts lifting.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Die lift/strike and halves slide are removed; state swaps instantly.

motion.name: tick-cross
motion.purpose: Checked WebRTC cross draws stroke by stroke; the second starts 90ms later. Runs only after the popup settles and when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: envelope-flap
motion.purpose: WebRTC envelope seals after the popup settles, only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion.name: envelope-seal
motion.purpose: Printed-red wax lands after the flap folds; subject to the same settled and motion gates.

motion.name: helper-slip-reveal
motion.purpose: Hover reveal of the ink helper slip; keyboard focus uses 140ms ease-out without delay.

masks.name: ink-impression
masks.value: img/ink-die.png, img/ink-lines.png + bleed filter (feGaussianBlur 0.3; feFuncA linear slope 2.4 intercept -0.45)
masks.purpose: Pressed-ink texture on the die and cancel lines.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: 1.5px ink outline, 4px corner; one deliberate action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1.5px solid rgb(var(--ink)); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--ink)); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: rgb(var(--ink) / 0.06); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--red)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button (pending)
components.description: The popup primary action; fills printed red when a change waits to apply.

components.name: Link Button
components.description: Underlined faded-ink text for secondary removals.

components.name: Address Line
components.description: A typed line on a hairline under a postal-form label; red on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; width: 180px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; color: rgb(var(--ink-2)); font-size: 11px; font-stretch: 88%; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-address-line { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; width: 100%; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--rule)); border-radius: 0; color: rgb(var(--ink)); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 6px 0 7px; caret-color: rgb(var(--red)); transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-address-line::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--ink-3)); font-weight: 400; } .ds-address-line:hover { border-bottom-color: rgb(var(--ink-3)); } .ds-address-line:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: rgb(var(--red)); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(var(--red)); }

components.name: Scope Tabs
components.description: Text tabs on a hairline; the active tab takes a 2px printed-red underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--rule)); width: 320px; } .ds-tabs [role="tab"] { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; background: none; border: 0; color: rgb(var(--ink-2)); padding: 10px 0 9px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 rgb(var(--red)); transition: color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs [role="tab"]:hover { color: rgb(var(--ink)); } .ds-tabs [role="tab"][aria-selected="true"] { color: rgb(var(--ink)); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(var(--red-fill)); } .ds-tabs [role="tab"]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--red)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stealth | Deep Switch
components.description: Two ink-bordered halves with a fixed seam, mirrored inner corners and a printed-red fill behind the checked half.
components.css: .ds-halves{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));border:1.5px solid rgb(var(--ink));border-radius:4px;isolation:isolate}.ds-halves:after,.ds-halves:before{content:"";position:absolute}.ds-halves:before{inset:0 50% 0 0;border-radius:2.5px 0 0 2.5px;background:rgb(var(--red-fill));z-index:-1;transition:transform .26s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-radius .26s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-halves:has(label:last-child input:checked):before{transform:translateX(100%);border-radius:0 2.5px 2.5px 0}.ds-halves:after{inset:0 auto 0 calc(50% - .75px);width:1.5px;background:rgb(var(--ink))}.ds-halves label{display:flex;cursor:pointer;align-items:center;justify-content:center;--tw-text-opacity:1;color:rgb(var(--ink)/var(--tw-text-opacity));padding:6px 14px 7px;transition:color .2s ease-out,background-color .2s ease-out}.ds-halves label:first-child{border-radius:2.5px 0 0 2.5px}.ds-halves label:last-child{border-radius:0 2.5px 2.5px 0}.ds-halves label:not(:has(input:checked)):hover{background:rgb(var(--ink)/.06)}.ds-halves label:has(input:checked){color:rgb(var(--on-red-fill))}.ds-halves label:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2px solid rgb(var(--red));outline-offset:3px}.ds-halves .ds-half-title{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-halves:before{transition:none}}.ds-halves{font-family:Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif;display:inline-grid}.ds-halves input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}

components.name: WebRTC Tick Boxes
components.description: Open and Sealed radios with ink crosses and accessible helper slips. Saved-state preview is still; the popup enables cross motion only after its first render and when reduced motion is not requested.
components.html:
Chrome's default. On a VPN that carries everything, sites see only the VPN's IP. A proxy or split tunnel can let WebRTC show your real one.
WebRTC stops asking servers for your IP. Calls go through a relay, so they may take a moment longer to connect.

narrative.overview:
A postmark is the original alibi: proof that a letter was in one city at one time. Alibi strikes that proof for the browser. The world is a piece of airmail. Envelope-white stock, blue-black cancellation ink, and a red, white and blue chevron edge along the top. The one live object is a circular cancellation die that names the place and keeps its local time. It is struck slightly askew, the way a hand stamp lands, and the ink is visibly imperfect.

Density is that of a postal form: small, exact labels over typed lines, everything set in one variable family (Archivo) and moved along its width axis rather than swapped for a second face. Condensed caps belong to the die, near-normal widths to the interface, tabular figures to anything that counts. Colour is mostly ink on stock. Red marks state and blue marks the post office's own voice (links, the gummed label). At night the envelope turns to airmail navy and the ink to paper white, but the printed chevron does not change.

The system rejects the category default it was built against: no dark VPN panel, no shield, no big on/off toggle. Depth comes from ink and paper, not from cards and shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Envelope stock and cancellation ink, with a night-airmail navy scheme.
A fixed airmail chevron edge as the brand stripe, at the top of every surface.
One variable family, Archivo, used across its width axis (72% to 100%).
Fields typed onto hairline rules, never boxed.
A cancellation die with a live clock, per-place tilt, an ink-impression mask and a lift-then-strike re-stamp.
Red for the one active state, blue for links and the gummed label.

rules.name: The Fill-Versus-Ink Rule
rules.body: Fills use printed values and text uses legible values. Filled red is always `red-fill` with white text, in both schemes. The lighter `night-red` is only ever text or a ring. The label works the same way: a deep printed blue ground, a lighter blue for link text.

rules.name: The Printed Stock Rule
rules.body: The airmail chevron is printed on the envelope, so it is red `#c41e2a`, white and blue `#1f3f91` in both schemes. Never theme it.

rules.name: The State-Red Rule
rules.body: Red marks state: the active choice, a pending action, focus and errors. Ordinary content stays in ink. On the guide, red numbers the steps of a procedure and does nothing else.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy moves along `wdth` as well as weight: 72–80% for the die, 84–86% for display, 88–92% for labels and titles, 100% for the interface. Do not bring in a second family for contrast.

rules.name: The Counting Figures Rule
rules.body: Times, dates, UTC offsets, coordinates, locales in the meta line, version numbers and step numerals use tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`). Running prose turns them off.

rules.name: The 600px Rule
rules.body: Chrome caps a popup at 600px tall, so the popup's tallest state, Stealth with the User Scripts label showing, must fit in 600px without scrolling. It measures 597px. This is why the die is 128px and not larger, and why WebRTC is one line under the mode row rather than a second switch row of its own (that cost 43px and made the popup scroll). Check every addition against that state.

rules.name: The One Notice Rule
rules.body: The popup shows at most one notice at a time. An error (a field error or a failed IP lookup) outranks the User Scripts label, which comes back once the error clears. Never stack a label on top of an error.

rules.name: The Ink Not Elevation Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand apart, change its ink, rule or fill. Never lift it with a shadow.

dos: Do put the airmail chevron edge at the top of every surface (6px in the popup, 10px on full pages), in its fixed printed red, white and blue.
Do fill active states with `red-fill` and white text in both schemes. Keep `airmail-red` and `night-red` for red text, carets and focus rings.
Do set fields as address lines: an 11px uppercase label above a typed line on a 1px hairline that turns red on focus.
Do use tabular figures for every time, date, offset, coordinate and step number.
Do keep the popup's tallest state within 600px, and show one notice at a time.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion fallback that swaps state instantly.
donts: Don't box inputs, put them on cards, or give them a filled background.
Don't theme the chevron edge, or use the lighter `night-red` as a fill.
Don't use shadows for elevation. A shadow in this system is only ever a 1–2px line.
Don't run cancel lines or the impression texture behind text that must be read.
Don't add a second typeface. Vary Archivo's width and weight instead.
Don't fall back to the category default this world replaces: a dark VPN panel, a shield, a big on/off toggle.
